verdict.rationale: Attio ships a visual Workflows automation builder, so versioning, review, and rollback of automations is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence documents workflow version history, change review, or rollback. The 'full history of every interaction' claim concerns record and interaction data, not automations. Any code-level versioning of App SDK workflow blocks would be a developer building block or user-side workaround, which earns no credit.
